title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Testing — Runnable Examples
title_es: Testing de Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — Ejemplos ejecutables
description: IaC testing toolkit: an OPA/Rego policy for terraform plan JSON, a native terraform test suite (1.6+), a three-job GitHub Actions gate with Checkov SARIF upload, a cron-ready drift check, and a tflint config.
description_es: Toolkit de testing de IaC: una política OPA/Rego para el JSON de terraform plan, una suite nativa de terraform test (1.6+), un gate de GitHub Actions en tres jobs con subida SARIF de Checkov, un chequeo de drift para cron y una config de tflint.
